official_reference_pages.label: WHO Growth Reference 2007: growth reference data for ages 5–19 years

pending_clearance_details: All six tables match WHO-owned anthroplus R; verify that embedded data are granted under GPL and that transformation and source-form obligations are met.

r_package.copyright_holder: World Health Organization (as declared in R package DESCRIPTION)
r_package.name: anthroplus

r_package_usage_and_packaging_basis: WHO's GPL (>= 3) anthroplus package provides independent WHO 2007 coefficient cross-validation and usage conventions. Published tables were independently normalized and compiled into a versioned, digest-verified Python data distribution.
scientific_values_origin: The values are derived from WHO Growth Reference 2007 official downloadable coefficient tables. Independently normalized LMS values match the corresponding sex- and age-specific coefficients embedded in the official WHO anthroplus R package. The package's application of the growth reference and published underlying source metadata informed validation.

validation.independent_oracle: WHO-authored anthroplus R 1.1.0 LMS tables and independent z-score output
validation.input_origin: WHO 2007 official downloadable growth-reference spreadsheets, normalized into LMS coefficients with source hashes
validation.limitations: R comparisons are scientific validation, not a separate license grant for official WHO published downloads.
